title.narrative: SIDERSA: Supporting the transition towards green steel production in Argentina

description.narrative: SIDERSA S.A. ("SIDERSA" or the "Company") is an Argentine company specialized in the commercialization and distribution of high-quality steel products. The Company is dedicated to providing comprehensive steel solutions, offering a wide range of products such as sheets, coils, profiles, and tubes, which are used in various industries, including construction, mining, energy, automotive, and agribusiness.The transaction consists of financing for the construction and commissioning of a new steel mill that will use metal scrap as raw material in San Nicolás de los Arroyos, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina (the "Project"). The total investment of the Project amounts to approximately US$300 million, of which BID Invest is structuring a Sustainability-Linked Loan ("SLL") guaranteed on a long-term basis for up to US$100 million.
